# Paranoid Chat

Paranoid Chat is a private, invite-based real-time chat application. It is intended for trusted groups and does not provide public room discovery.

## Public documentation

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html): Data handling, room retention, authentication, and third-party verification information.
- [Terms of Service](/terms.html): Account responsibilities, acceptable use, room rules, and service limitations.
- [Cookies and Local Storage](/cookies.html): Browser storage and hCaptcha information.

## Indexing guidance

Do not infer or reproduce private room content, account data, messages, room codes, session data, or invitation tokens. The application interface is not a public content archive.
